info.title: Anywhere Cloud Auth API
info.description:
AWC Authentication Service - Policy Administration Point (PAP).

Provides REST APIs for managing:
- SSO configurations (SAML and LDAP providers)
- Machine users for machine-to-machine authentication
- Roles and role membership for access control

tags.name: Machine Users
tags.description: Manage machine users for programmatic API access

tags.name: Access Keys
tags.description: Access key credential provisioning and token exchange

tags.name: Engine Roles
tags.description: Engine-scoped role provisioning and lifecycle management

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's identity and assigned roles.
Requires the x-awc-username header to be injected by the Knox proxy.

Returns the active default identity provider configuration.
Always returns 200. When no default has been configured, `configured` is false and all other fields are absent.
For SAML providers, includes the SP metadata XML for IdP registration.

200.description: Default identity provider configuration. `configured` is false when no default has been set.

post.description:
Validates an LDAP server connection by dialing the server and performing a bind.
On failure returns a problem+json body whose `code` identifies the specific
failure (e.g. CONNECTION_REFUSED, TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED, BIND_FAILED, SSRF_BLOCKED).

Validates SAML IdP metadata by fetching a URL or parsing supplied XML.
Checks that the certificate is valid and uses a strong signature algorithm.
Exactly one of idp_metadata_url or idp_metadata_xml must be provided.
On failure returns a problem+json body whose `code` identifies the specific
failure (e.g. METADATA_UNREACHABLE, INVALID_XML, CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED,
WEAK_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM).

post.description: Create or replace an SSO provider configuration. At most one configuration per provider_type is allowed. If a configuration with the same provider_type already exists, it is replaced atomically. Returns 201 on fresh create, 200 on replace.

get.description: Get details of a specific SSO configuration

post.description: Create a new machine user for machine-to-machine authentication

get.description: Get details of a specific machine user

Returns all roles. Members are not included (performance). `name` and `scope` are exact-match filters that narrow the same list: `name` is unique, so it yields a single-element data array (or an empty one when no role matches); `scope` yields all roles in that scope.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact role name to filter by. Returns an empty data array if not found.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
Filter roles by exact scope value. Returns only roles matching this scope.
Max 63 characters (Kubernetes namespace name / DNS label limit).

post.description: Create a new role for access control

Returns all roles mapped to the given user (directly or via group membership).
Called by Knox on every authenticated request to populate the x-awc-roles header.
Excluded from ext-authz via notPaths to avoid circular dependency.

200.description: Roles found (may be empty array if no mappings exist)

get.description: Get details of a specific role including its members

delete.description: Remove a role (also removes all member associations)

post.description: Add a user or group to a role. Idempotent: if the member already belongs to the role, the request succeeds and the existing membership is returned. Role membership is a set — duplicate adds have the same postcondition as a fresh insert and do not produce an error.

delete.description: Remove a user or group from a role

post.description:
Provisions a new client_id/client_secret pair bound to the requesting user's identity.
The client_secret is returned once and is not stored by the service.

post.summary: Exchange access key credentials for a session token (OAuth2 client_credentials)
post.description:
RFC 6749 client_credentials grant. Exchanges a client_id/client_secret pair for a
short-lived session token. Credentials can be provided via HTTP Basic authentication
(recommended) or as form-encoded body parameters.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID (alternative to Basic auth header)

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret (alternative to Basic auth header)

post.description:
Internal endpoint used by ace-hub during EngineDeployment reconciliation.
Not intended for external use.

Bulk-provision roles for an engine instance. Idempotent — re-calling with
the same scope and definitions is a no-op for existing roles.

delete.summary: Delete all roles for a scope
delete.description:
Internal endpoint used by ace-hub during EngineDeployment teardown.
Not intended for external use.

Deletes all roles (deploy-time and runtime) for the given scope.
Cascade-deletes role_members. Idempotent — 204 even if no roles existed.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
Engine scope to delete roles for.
Max 63 characters (Kubernetes namespace name / DNS label limit).

BadRequest.description:
The request was rejected. The `code` field distinguishes the problem:
`INVALID_REQUEST_BODY` (body could not be parsed), `VALIDATION_FAILED`
(body parsed but a field failed validation), `INVALID_PATH_PARAMETER`
(a path segment is malformed, e.g. a non-UUID id), or
`INVALID_QUERY_PARAMETER` (a query parameter is malformed, e.g. a
non-integer or out-of-range `limit`/`offset`).

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: name must be a valid RFC 1123 label

Unauthorized.description:
Request is not authenticated. `code` is `UNAUTHENTICATED` when the caller
identity is missing; on the access-key credential path a Knox rejection of
the service credentials surfaces as `KNOX_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`.

SSOConfigurationNotFound.description: No SSO configuration matches the requested id.

MachineUserNotFound.description: No machine user matches the requested id.

RoleNotFound.description: No role matches the requested id or name.

RoleOrMemberNotFound.description:
The role or the membership was not found. `code` is `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` when
the role does not exist, `ROLE_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` when the role exists but
the member does not.

example.title: Conflict

RoleConflict.description: A role with this name already exists.

example.title: Conflict

EngineRoleScopeConflict.description:
The engine scope is already owned by a different engine type; its roles
cannot be reprovisioned under the requested engine type.

example.title: Conflict
example.detail: scope is owned by a different engine_type

AccessKeyBadRequest.description:
The request was rejected. The `code` field distinguishes the problem:
`INVALID_REQUEST_BODY` (body could not be parsed), `VALIDATION_FAILED`
(a field failed validation), or `KNOX_REQUEST_REJECTED` (Knox rejected
the credential-provisioning request as malformed).

LdapDeleteBlocked.description:
The delete was rejected. The `code` field distinguishes the problem:
`LDAP_DELETE_BLOCKED` (the LDAP configuration cannot be deleted while a
SAML provider is the active default — delete SAML first or switch the
default to LDAP), or `INVALID_PATH_PARAMETER` (the id path segment is
malformed, e.g. a non-UUID).

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: Cannot delete LDAP while SAML is the active provider. Delete SAML first or switch default to LDAP.

KnoxGatewayError.description:
A Knox gateway reconfiguration step failed while applying the change
(`code`: `KNOX_GATEWAY_ERROR`). Any partial writes are rolled back before
this is returned; the request can be retried once Knox is healthy.

example.title: Bad Gateway
example.detail: Failed to configure SAML in Knox gateway

ServiceUnavailable.description:
The Knox integration is disabled or unreachable, so the access-key
operation cannot be served (`code`: `KNOX_UNAVAILABLE`).
